subject: Choosing serving lane for NovaMed — recap & next milestones
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap — hosting lanes and where we landed

Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposal for next steps so we don't lose momentum.

What we heard from your team (confirm / correct if I missed anything):
- Primary goal: ship intelligent document ingestion + summarization for clinical intake forms with sub-second interactive latency for triage UI.
- Hard constraints: PHI, must meet Novamed security baseline (SOC2 + customer-managed key), and audit logs for retention policy (7 yrs).
- Current environment: legacy GPU cluster + an existing vendor API for non-PHI traffic, planning a migration in phases.
- Preference: want a solution that minimizes rewrite of existing inference calls (proxy-friendly).

Where Redwood maps: Hosted API gives fastest time-to-value but needs VPC or token-scope isolation for PHI; Dedicated capacity provides isolated GPUs with predictable throughput and private networking options; Private (VPC/on-prem) is the fully isolated option that satisfies strict KMS/HSM requirements.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Shared security artifact: we attached a one-page SOC2 summary and the demo metric export so your security team can skim. (attachment: novamed-soc2-summary.pdf)
2) Quick mapping call with your security + infra (30 min) to validate whether Dedicated + VPC peering is sufficient versus Private on-prem.
3) Example mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines — I sketched a 6-week pilot for a Dedicated orbit, and a parallel compliance review for Private.

Ask: can you confirm availability for the security/infra call this week or early next? Also — can procurement share any timing or procurement gating items so Karthik can align on price/commitments?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]
[attachment: novamed-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 450KB)]

From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — hosting lanes and where we landed

Jordan — thanks for the concise recap. That captures the meeting well. A couple clarifications from our side:

- PHI: anything with patient identifiers must stay inside a Novamed-controlled VPC or on-prem. We can consider Dedicated if it sits inside our VPC (VPC peering or private link) and the keys are customer-managed.
- Latency: interactive is ideal but the triage UI can tolerate 200–300ms P95. The bigger blocker is auditability and retention — SOC2 evidence + per-request audit IDs.
- Migration: prefer a staged approach. Phase 1: non-PHI traffic -> hosted API for feature parity. Phase 2: PD (PHI data) -> Dedicated/VPC or Private, depending on security review.

Procurement note: we have a formal vendor security review that will take 2–3 weeks after we receive the SOC2 evidence and an answer on key management. Doc is attached.

I can do the security/infra call Wednesday 23rd at 10am PT. Does that work?

— Emma
Emma Lawson
Head of Cloud Engineering, NovaMed
[attachment: novamed-security-review.xlsx (XLSX, 110KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — hosting lanes and where we landed

Emma — perfect, thanks. Wed 23rd 10am PT is on our calendar (I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + pre-read).

What Karthik and I will bring to the call:
- A short comparison doc (attached) showing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for your exact use case (cost projection for the pilot, integration touches, and KMS flow).
- A suggested pilot proposal: 4-week non-PHI hosted pilot to validate model prompts + infra, followed by a 6-week Dedicated pilot for PHI with VPC peering if the security review lands there.

Open questions for security/infra team to help decide during the call:
- Is VPC peering or PrivateLink preferred by your networking team?
- Does Novamed require an HSM-backed KMS for production keys or will cloud KMS with customer-managed keys suffice?
- Are there any egress restrictions that would force on-prem compute?

Attachments included: redwood-mamp-lane-comparison.pdf, nova-demo-metrics.xlsx

If procurement can share target contract dates or a preferred PO flow, Karthik will tailor the Dedicated pricing to match your procurement windows.

Thanks — Jordan
[attachment: redwood-mamp-lane-comparison.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]
[attachment: nova-demo-metrics.xlsx (XLSX, 58KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@novamed.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — hosting lanes and where we landed

Emma / Jordan — quick procurement & sizing note ahead of Wednesday's call:

- Sizing: for the triage UI and projected 600 concurrent sessions during business hours, we estimate a Dedicated pool of 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (steady) with a 6 GPU burst to handle peaks. I included ballpark QPS and cost in the MAP doc.
- Commercial: we can offer a 6-month pilot rate for Dedicated that migrates into a monthly reserved commitment if you choose to continue. I can prep two term options for the PO team: 6-month pilot vs 12-month reserved.
- Migration path from legacy: we recommend a proxy approach where your current inference calls are routed to Redwood endpoints (minimal code changes) and we stage model parity first on non-PHI traffic. For legacy GPU lift-and-shift, we can provide tooling to export KV caches and model artifacts to reduce cold-start cost.

I'll bring a draft SOW + two pricing options to the call. If procurement wants an initial redline, have them send a mark to the drive link (shared in the calendar invite).

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions & Commercials, Redwood Inference
